body.note: Phase 23.3's parameterization proof. The 3.6.4 production authority is the pivot: its plane is byte-identical after the refactor, and the historical authority openssl-0.9.8zh-historical is produced through the same code path, with every plane the release does not have recorded as a measured absence (a counted zero with its manifest and epoch as provenance).

same_code_path.note: one generator and one plane set serve every authority; each census differs only in what that authority's own committed manifest measures, so an older authority produces a measured absence instead of an empty modern assumption

body.selection: the default authority is read from the committed alias, never from the catalogue's `latest-stable` (openssl-4.0.3) and never from a version sort; an explicit `--authority` overrides it
